title: Perception

  • 1. Cakkhuvagga 1. The Eye

Rūpasaññāsutta Perception

Sāvatthinidānaṁ. At Sāvatthī.

“Rūpasaññā, bhikkhave, aniccā vipariṇāmī aññathābhāvī; “Mendicants, perception of sights is impermanent, decaying, and perishing. saddasaññā … Perception of sounds, gandhasaññā … perception of smells, rasasaññā … perception of tastes, phoṭṭhabbasaññā … perception of touches, dhammasaññā aniccā vipariṇāmī aññathābhāvī. and perception of ideas are impermanent, decaying, and perishing.

Yo, bhikkhave, ime dhamme evaṁ saddahati adhimuccati, ayaṁ vuccati ‘saddhānusārī …pe… Someone who has faith and confidence in these teachings is called a follower by faith. …” sambodhiparāyano’”ti.

Chaṭṭhaṁ.
